outputs.DETERMINISM_NOTES: No test-name, hidden-input or environment-specific branching is used. Fixed source overlays are applied deterministically, formatted, tested and built from the registered command entrypoint.
outputs.PRESERVED_BEHAVIOR: The public serve/validate CLI, JSON configuration schema, operator configuration/discovery APIs, HTTP data plane, health/status/readiness/metrics/events surfaces, routing policies and durable state directory remain intact.
outputs.RESTART_IDEMPOTENCY_BEHAVIOR: Repeated solution application reconstructs the same repaired runtime; restart recovery validates durable checkpoint authority before readiness and falls back to a previous complete generation when current recovery state is invalid.
RESTORED_INVARIANTS: Per-source revision and digest authority is fenced under serialized acceptance; rejected or conflicting updates do not alter accepted metadata.
Candidate validation, runtime reconciliation, checkpoint preparation, publication and acknowledgement preserve last-known-good serving state on rejection.
Serving publication exposes one complete immutable runtime snapshot and each request holds one generation lease through match, affinity, retry and failover.
Canonical endpoint identity and incarnation semantics preserve compatible unchanged runtime state while remove/re-add creates a new incarnation.
Fresh selection excludes ineligible endpoints while already-leased generations may complete bounded work on draining endpoints.
Checkpoint bodies and CURRENT authority follow durable ordering and recovery verifies current state before falling back to a previous complete generation.
Retired snapshots, endpoint runtimes, transports, affinity state and telemetry are bounded and reclaimed after lifecycle completion.
RISKS_FOR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER: Independent verification should stress concurrent publication with leased requests, source-local fencing, remove/re-add incarnation changes, all-unhealthy selection, bounded draining and checkpoint fallback.
